'''Henrik Ekman''' (born 22 June 1951) is a Swedish author, television presenter and producer.

Ekman is also a [[freelance journalist]] and has also been working for [[Sveriges Television|SVT]] with finding and buying rights for nature and science programmes for the channel. He was the presenter of ''Vetenskapens värld,'' which was broadcast on SVT between 2002 and 2007.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://vipatv.svt.se/204/priser/arkiv-for-priser/2014-01-30-henrik-ekman-fick-miljopris.html|title=Henrik Ekman fick miljöpris |website=vipatv.svt.se|accessdate=30 November 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181130202103/https://vipatv.svt.se/204/priser/arkiv-for-priser/2014-01-30-henrik-ekman-fick-miljopris.html|archive-date=30 November 2018|url-status=live}}</ref>

In January 2014, Ekman was awarded the environmental prize by the Engineers of Sweden.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.nyteknik.se/energi/han-far-sveriges-ingenjorers-miljopris-6401016|title=Han får Sveriges Ingenjörers miljöpris|publisher=Ny teknik|language=Swedish|author=Olle Nygårds|date=13 January 2014|accessdate=12 March 2014}}</ref>
